svg.text: Dotnet · D15 · Order is a dependency: routing before authorization
Exception wrap, then route, then identity, then the action.
Pipeline vs MVC stages — do not mix the nouns.
Late exception mw and early authz both fail for different reasons.
Registration order in; reverse on the way out.
Metadata exists only after routing selected the endpoint.
One order you can draw without stalling.

text.tspan: Trace Kestrel → exception → route → authn/z → action
Authorize before routing and wonder why it is open
